notes.title: Between Two Worlds is now Finished and Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, adventurers! Between Two Worlds is now a full and complete game, as promised!

Nearly 10,000 FHD Renders in total,

notes.title: Final Chapter 10 Dev Update + Previews!
notes.content:
Ah, tired adventurer! Please, come inside from that dreadful weather and warm yourself next to the hearth!

Hello, everyone! This will be the final Dev Update for Chapter 10, and the game as a whole. What an incredible journey this has been! It's just about time to face down the final boss, or our own demons, depending on which path you took.

Alpha testing for the update will begin this weekend. My testers will have access to roughly 70% of the update at that time, giving them the opportunity to destroy my hopes and dreams (aka, make me fix stuff). They have also been going through the rest of the game, finding the smaller things that need corrections still. Nothing major, just misspellings, grammar issues, things like that. But they will all be fixed in the update.

At this time, I'm expecting things to wrap up in ~8 weeks. Again, this accounts for all of the endings coming in a single update. They won't be released piecemeal. The translators are all doing their part as well, to ensure that those are ready to go.

So, how about a few previews then. Here you go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/534a2b4864fd66dffc91e50e0dd40b1899d8eb30.jpg[/img]

Also, I saw what you all were telling me about the follow up title. The title has now been slightly modified and will now be [i]Darkness and Desire[/i]. Thank you! If you have any questions, as always, feel free to ask! I'm always looking back at these announcements to answer!

Final note: In the days leading up to the release, I'll be doing daily announcements with special renders to celebrate the big finale. Hope you enjoy them!

-Droosk

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/85dbdde9a80499bd6c919906af67622c02047103.png[/img]

The penultimate chapter of Between Two Worlds has arrived! It's time to head back to Euchora as we move toward the final conflicts! What paths have your choices led you down? Have you landed on the side of good, or have you succumbed to the temptations of evil?

[list]

Special Announcement! To celebrate the release and to embrace the community, I'm going to be doing a bit of a giveaway. Anyone who comments on this announcement will be entered into a drawing. Two names will be drawn at random, and those two people will be allowed to request a special 4k artwork featuring characters from the game. They will be able to pick who is in the art and the general environment to place them in. I'll then do the artwork for the winners!

So, if you want to have a chance to win the art, just comment on this announcement! Entries will be accepted for 72 hours, and the winners will be selected, notified, and announced within 24 hours after that. [b]Giveaway has ended, thank you![/b]

Thank you everyone for your ongoing support, and enjoy your return to Euchora!

-Droosk

notes.title: Planned Sequel Announcement!
notes.content:
I'd like to announce that I've officially started work on the follow up project to Between Two Worlds.

[b][h1]Beyond Two Worlds​[/h1][/b]

This project will explore what happens to our group of adventurers after the end of BTW, if you were to side with Alorine. The evil is over-powering, causing significant changes to your friends. Below, you can see the impact it has had on Hannah. Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Open world exploration in Unreal Engine 5
[*] Up to 8 person multi-player for more realistic group sex experiences
[*] AI based real-time interactions with NPCs
[*] Full voiceover, with Scarlett Johansson playing Hannah, and Sean Connery playing the MC
[*] Adaptive enemies that will use machine learning to predict your plans and counter your efforts
[*] Evolving storylines that will take you out of Euchora and into space
[*] Microtransactions to buy your way into the panties of various girls, skipping the need to actually try
[*] Early Supporters will receive up to FIVE free cosmetic accessory crates during the beta (All cosmetics will be removed upon Full Release)
[/list]

I can't wait to start working on this new project full-time! I think it has some amazing potential, and I'm certain you'll love it as much as I do!

-Droosk

notes.title: Chapter 7 Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/35b26eb446d66bc7c5008f3732a501da02c3ab25.png[/img]

[h1]Chapter 7 is nearly here![/h1]

Hello everyone! Yes, you read that correctly. It's almost time to continue the journey through Euchora! I'm tearing through the final stages of the update as quickly as I possibly can. As I write this, both computers are churning away through the renders and animations. Tomorrow will be a major coding day so that I can get the script out to my translators. Everything is coming together!

So, what can you expect?

Right now, I'm targeting Thursday, June 22nd*. That's less than 4 weeks from now! Chapter 7 is absolutely loaded with important decisions, branching paths, and in-depth narrative. That means they have to go through every possible choice and branch to make sure it not only works, but sticks to the story so far.

In addition, I know there was some complaint about the music usage in Chapter 6. I heard you, I listened. Chapter 7 will be significantly more diverse in music and sound effects. I intend to eventually go back and remaster the Chapter 6 music, but right now my focus is on delivering Chapter 7 to you.

I'm also working on an eventual chapter selection system, which will allow people to replay content on demand, but that's also something that is down the road. Due to the way that Between Two Worlds flows, and the implementation of the alignment system, it's a difficult project that will need to be tackled carefully to ensure it's done correctly. But it [i]will[/i] happen!

One final note. I have recently contracted someone to provide Simplified Chinese translations. I am hoping to have the game fully translated shortly after the release of Chapter 7. So for those of you who have been requesting that, it's coming! The native Italian translation is also ongoing, and will continue being implemented as it's finished.

That's it for now! I need to get back to work and finish this thing up.

Thanks for your continued interest. This journey isn't over yet!

-Droosk

Edit: Corrected dates. Had to redo a bunch of animations due to incorrect settings :(

Edit edit: Final change to release date. Adding 5 days, to June 22nd. This is to ensure that the translators have sufficient time to finish their work and get it checked. This will also allow for more in depth beta testing.

notes.title: Chapter 7 Development Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's time for an update on development and I'm excited to bring it to you. The worst is done, which was the design and creation of a bunch of all new environments. I had to learn new lighting techniques and processes, in addition to actually making it. But that is done, and work is moving along quickly. Here are some hard numbers:

[b]Environment Design - 85%[/b]
[b]Writing - 74%[/b]
[b]Rendering - 53%[/b]
[b]Animation - 60%[/b]
[b]Code - 53%[/b]

There are a total of 19 scenes being worked on for the chapter, with clearly defined pathing. Each path, good vs evil, will get 13 full and unique scenes, in addition to a bunch of splitting within the remaining shared 6 scenes. For those playing both paths, this chapter is shaping up to provide 3+ hours of new content.

Right now, I'm trying to get at least two scenes posed and rendered per week minimum. The beta test team has already run through the first half of Chapter 7 and the issues they found have all been addressed. This matters because it cuts down the testing and fixing once the update is finished. Letting them go through it while I continue working makes everything go even faster.

If everything goes to plan, I am hoping to have the full update in their hands in ~5 weeks, and then out to all of you about a week after that.

That's it for this dev update! I plan to do one more in a few weeks with final notes before digging in for the final run. Can't wait to see your theories and ideas once Chapter 7 comes out!

-Droosk

notes.title: Chapter 7 Dev Update!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Time for an official dev update and preview image. Things are going well, and rendering is well underway. Update is a little over halfway done, and I'm picking up speed as I move into the second half of the chapter. I've made some incredible new environments for our group as they move through Euchora, along with some interesting new situations.

As I've said before, the paths will continue to diverge with Chapter 7. Some of the choices you make will cause major jumps in one direction or another. One decision in particular could end up locking you onto a path that you'll be unable to recover from (in terms of good or evil). So make sure you put that new "Named Saves" functionality to use! In case you didn't know, you can enable it in the Preferences menu.

Don't forget, we have a Discord server linked on the main store page. If you're interested in more frequent updates (or general game or off topic conversation!), you should check it out. I'm always active there, and I love to interact with all of you.

I'm aiming to finish the update within 6 to 7 weeks, depending on how the beta testing goes. As with the previous updates, it'll be another 2-3 hours of content on average, and move both the story and relationships forward.

I'll be back soon with another preview!

-Droosk

notes.title: Merry Christmas to all adventurers!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm here to provide a quick status update about Chapter 6, and to share a bit of Christmas cheer. Some of you may have seen this image before, but that's okay. You can still enjoy it!

So, first we'll touch on what you actually want to know. "When is the update?!?" Well, good news! Update will almost certainly be coming on Tuesday! The renders are done, animations are encoded, story is written, code is completed. Beta Testers will be getting their hands on the near final version tonight to make sure there are no game breaking bugs.

Granted, while I may be working throughout Christmas day to get this done, I don't expect them to do the same. So I'll probably get the results of the beta testing tomorrow (Monday). I'll make adjustments/fixes/corrections based on their feedback in preparation for the final release. So, it's coming!

I've already started working on Chapter 7, to ensure it has a smaller dev cycle. My early target will be 10-12 weeks.

Here is the preliminary change log for Chapter 6. Note, this is not the final version, just something to give an idea of what can be expected:

[list]
[*] ~1,000 new renders
[*] ~30+ new animations
[*] 2+ hours of additional story
[*] Gallery with unique renders for each scene of the game
[*] Ability to name your saves, so you can better track the paths you're on
[/list]

I can't wait to see your feedback and see you all enjoying the new content! I'll be back in a couple days to make it happen!

-Droosk

P.S. Did you know that Between Two Worlds is now part of a bundle? That's right! Even if you already own BTW, you can save extra money by buying the bundle which will get you Love of Magic, Price of Power, and To Be a King. You should check it out on the store page!
